purpose: Targeted frontier refinement. Locates the largest A meeting the 95% reachability requirement at J=160mm (bracketed by tier 1 between 206 and 249 mm), and tests the J=20 and J=40 mm rows of the selection table outside the original A grid, where they had never been examined.
id_overlap_note: Tiers 1 and 2 both number from 900001; the pair (tag, experiment_id) is the unique key, and tag is recorded in every result file's _run_meta. Tier 3 numbers from 930001.
